pairs: Post hæc audivi quasi vocem turbarum multarum in cælo dicentium:
I heard something like the voice of many multitudes in heaven,
Praise and glory and power is for our God.
quia vera et justa judicia sunt ejus,
quæ corrupit terram in prostitutione sua,
he who has judged the great harlot that corrupted the earth by her prostitution.
et vindicavit sanguinem servorum suorum de manibus ejus.
And he has vindicated the blood of his servants from her hands.”
Et fumus ejus ascendit in sæcula sæculorum.
For her smoke ascends forever and ever.”
Et ceciderunt seniores viginti quatuor, et quatuor animalia,
And the twenty-four elders and the four living creatures fell down and worshiped God,
et adoraverunt Deum sedentem super thronum, dicentes:
And a voice went out from the throne,
Laudem dicite Deo nostro omnes servi ejus:
“Express praise to our God, all you his servants,
et qui timetis eum pusilli et magni.
and you who fear him, small and great.”
Et audivi quasi vocem turbæ magnæ,
And I heard something like the voice of a great multitude,
and like the voice of many waters,
et sicut vocem tonitruorum magnorum, dicentium:
and like the voice of great thunders, saying:
quoniam regnavit Dominus Deus noster omnipotens.
For the Lord our God, the Almighty, has reigned.
And let us give glory to him.
For the marriage feast of the Lamb has arrived,
and his wife has prepared herself.”
Et datum est illi ut cooperiat se byssino splendenti
And it was granted to her that she should cover herself with fine linen,
For the fine linen is the justifications of the Saints.
Beati qui ad cœnam nuptiarum Agni vocati sunt;
Blessed are those who have been called to the wedding feast of the Lamb.”
And I fell down before his feet,
et fratrum tuorum habentium testimonium Jesu.
and I am among your brothers, who hold to the testimony of Jesus.
Testimonium enim Jesu est spiritus prophetiæ.
For the testimony of Jesus is a spirit of prophecy.”
et qui sedebat super eum, vocabatur Fidelis, et Verax,
And he who was sitting upon it was called Faithful and True.
et cum justitia judicat et pugnat.
And with justice does he judge and fight.
Oculi autem ejus sicut flamma ignis,
And his eyes are like a flame of fire,
et in capite ejus diademata multa,
and on his head are many diadems,
which no one knows except himself.
Et vestitus erat veste aspersa sanguine:
And he was clothed with a vestment sprinkled with blood.
Et exercitus qui sunt in cælo,
And the armies that are in heaven were following him on white horses,
Et de ore ejus procedit gladius ex utraque parte acutus,
And from his mouth proceeded a sharp two-edged sword,
so that with it he may strike the nations.
Et ipse reget eas in virga ferrea:
And he shall rule them with an iron rod.
et ipse calcat torcular vini furoris iræ Dei omnipotentis.
And he treads the winepress of the fury of the wrath of God Almighty.
Et habet in vestimento et in femore suo scriptum:
And he has on his garment and on his thigh written:
KING OF KINGS AND LORD OF LORDS.
Et vidi unum angelum stantem in sole,
And I saw a certain Angel,
And he cried out with a great voice,
saying to all the birds that were flying through the midst of the sky,
et congregamini ad cœnam magnam Dei:
and gather together for the great supper of God,
so that you may eat the flesh of kings,
and the flesh of the strong,
et carnes equorum, et sedentium in ipsis,
and the flesh of horses and those sitting on them,
et servorum, et pusillorum et magnorum.
free and servant, small and great.”
and the kings of the earth
et exercitus eorum congregatos ad faciendum prælium cum illo,
having been gathered together to do battle against him who was sitting upon the horse,
and with him the false prophetess,
who in his presence caused the signs,
quibus seduxit eos, qui acceperunt caracterem bestiæ, et qui adoraverunt imaginem ejus.
by which she seduced those who accepted the character of the beast and who worshiped his image.
Vivi missi sunt hi duo in stagnum ignis ardentis sulphure:
These two were cast alive into the pool of fire burning with sulphur.
et ceteri occisi sunt in gladio sedentis super equum, qui procedit de ore ipsius:
And the others were slain by the sword that proceeds from the mouth of him who was sitting upon the horse.
et omnes aves saturatæ sunt carnibus eorum.
And all the birds were sated with their flesh.
